summary.en: Model real things with classes, constructors, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction and interfaces, and encapsulation.
summary.te: Classes, constructors, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, interfaces, encapsulation తో నిజమైన వస్తువులను రూపొందించడం.
summary.hi: Classes, constructors, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction और interfaces, और encapsulation से असली चीज़ें बनाना।

oneLine.en: A class describes a kind of thing with fields (data) and methods (actions); new makes an object from it.
oneLine.te: Class ఒక రకం వస్తువును fields (data), methods (పనులు) తో వర్ణిస్తుంది; new దానితో object చేస్తుంది.
oneLine.hi: Class किसी तरह की चीज़ को fields (data) और methods (काम) से बताती है; new उससे object बनाता है।

useCase.en: A hostel app has a Room class; each room object knows its number, its capacity and how many students are in it.
useCase.te: Hostel app లో Room class ఉంటుంది; ప్రతి room object కి తన number, capacity, ఎంతమంది విద్యార్థులు ఉన్నారో తెలుసు.
useCase.hi: Hostel app में Room class है; हर room object अपना number, capacity और उसमें कितने छात्र हैं, जानता है।

en: A class is a design; an object is one real thing built from it.
Fields are variables inside the class: int number; int capacity;
Methods inside the class use those fields, like boolean isFull().
Room r = new Room(); makes an object. r.number = 101; sets its field.
Each object has its own copy of the fields, so room 101 and room 102 do not mix.
te: Class అంటే రూపకల్పన; object అంటే దానితో కట్టిన ఒక నిజమైన వస్తువు.
Fields అంటే class లోపలి variables: int number; int capacity;
Class లోని methods ఆ fields ని వాడతాయి, boolean isFull() లాగా.
Room r = new Room(); object చేస్తుంది. r.number = 101; దాని field నింపుతుంది.
ప్రతి object కి fields సొంత copy ఉంటుంది, కాబట్టి room 101, room 102 కలవవు.
hi: Class एक design है; object उससे बनी एक असली चीज़।
Fields class के अंदर के variables हैं: int number; int capacity;
Class के methods उन fields को इस्तेमाल करते हैं, जैसे boolean isFull()।
Room r = new Room(); object बनाता है। r.number = 101; उसका field भरता है।
हर object की fields की अपनी copy होती है, इसलिए room 101 और room 102 आपस में नहीं मिलते।

en: The class is the form; each object is one filled form.
te: Class అంటే form; ప్రతి object ఒక నింపిన form.
hi: Class एक form है; हर object एक भरा हुआ form।

en: A Bus class with route and seatsLeft; bus1 and bus2 are two buses on different routes.
te: route, seatsLeft ఉన్న Bus class; bus1, bus2 వేర్వేరు routes లో రెండు buses.
hi: route और seatsLeft वाली Bus class; bus1 और bus2 अलग routes की दो buses।

q.hi: क्या दो Room objects अपनी fields साझा करते हैं?

prompt.en: Write class Book with fields String title and int pages, and a method boolean isLong() that is true when pages > 300. In main, make one book and print whether it is long.
prompt.te: String title, int pages fields, pages > 300 అయితే true ఇచ్చే boolean isLong() method ఉన్న Book class రాయండి. main లో ఒక book చేసి అది long అవునో కాదో print చేయండి.
prompt.hi: String title और int pages fields वाली Book class लिखिए, और boolean isLong() method जो pages > 300 पर true हो। main में एक book बनाकर print कीजिए कि वह long है या नहीं।

Name obj = new Name(); · obj.field · obj.method()

questions.en: A hostel has 50 rooms. Explain how a Room class and room objects would model them, with fields and one method.
questions.te: Hostel లో 50 rooms ఉన్నాయి. Room class, room objects వాటిని fields, ఒక method తో ఎలా రూపొందిస్తాయో వివరించండి.
questions.hi: Hostel में 50 rooms हैं। Room class और room objects उन्हें fields और एक method से कैसे दिखाएँगे, समझाइए।

questions.en: Explain what new does and why Room r; alone is not enough.
questions.te: new ఏం చేస్తుందో, Room r; ఒక్కటే ఎందుకు చాలదో వివరించండి.
questions.hi: new क्या करता है और सिर्फ़ Room r; क्यों काफ़ी नहीं, समझाइए।

challenge.en: Say the difference between a class and an object.
challenge.hi: Class और object का फ़र्क़ बताइए।

oneLine.en: A constructor is a special method that runs when you write new, and sets up the object's fields in one step.
oneLine.te: Constructor అంటే new రాసినప్పుడు నడిచే ప్రత్యేక method; object fields ని ఒకే step లో సిద్ధం చేస్తుంది.
oneLine.hi: Constructor एक ख़ास method है जो new लिखने पर चलता है और object की fields एक step में तैयार करता है।

useCase.en: A hostel app writes new Room(101, 3) and every room starts complete, instead of setting number and capacity line by line.
useCase.te: Hostel app new Room(101, 3) రాస్తుంది; number, capacity ని line by line కాకుండా ప్రతి room పూర్తిగా మొదలవుతుంది.
useCase.hi: Hostel app new Room(101, 3) लिखता है और हर room पूरा बनकर शुरू होता है, number और capacity एक-एक line में भरने की जगह।

en: A constructor has the class name and no return type, not even void: Room(int number, int capacity) { ... }.
new Room(101, 3) calls it with those values.
Inside, this.number = number; means "this object's number gets the parameter number".
You can have several constructors with different parameters (overloading), and one can call another with this(...).
If you write no constructor, Java gives an empty one; once you write one, that empty one is gone.
te: Constructor కి class పేరు ఉంటుంది, return type ఉండదు, void కూడా కాదు: Room(int number, int capacity) { ... }.
new Room(101, 3) ఆ values తో దాన్ని call చేస్తుంది.
లోపల this.number = number; అంటే "ఈ object number కి parameter number వస్తుంది".
వేర్వేరు parameters తో చాలా constructors ఉండవచ్చు (overloading); ఒకటి మరొకదాన్ని this(...) తో call చేయగలదు.
మీరు constructor రాయకపోతే Java ఖాళీది ఇస్తుంది; మీరు ఒకటి రాసిన తర్వాత ఆ ఖాళీది ఉండదు.
hi: Constructor का नाम class जैसा होता है और कोई return type नहीं, void भी नहीं: Room(int number, int capacity) { ... }।
new Room(101, 3) उन values के साथ उसे call करता है।
अंदर this.number = number; मतलब "इस object का number, parameter number बनता है"।
अलग parameters वाले कई constructors हो सकते हैं (overloading), और एक दूसरे को this(...) से call कर सकता है।
आप constructor न लिखें तो Java एक ख़ाली देता है; आप एक लिखें तो वह ख़ाली वाला नहीं रहता।

en: The constructor fills in the form the moment the object is born.
te: Object పుట్టిన క్షణంలోనే constructor form నింపుతుంది.
hi: Object बनते ही constructor form भर देता है।

note.hi: new constructor चलाता है।

fix.te: void తో అది సాధారణ method, constructor కాదు. void తీసేయండి.
fix.hi: void लगाने पर यह सामान्य method है, constructor नहीं। void हटाइए।

fix.en: This sets the parameter to itself. Write this.number = number;
fix.te: ఇది parameter ని తనకే ఇస్తుంది. this.number = number; రాయండి.
fix.hi: यह parameter को ख़ुद को ही देता है। this.number = number; लिखिए।

why.hi: दूसरे को दोबारा इस्तेमाल करता है।

prompt.en: Write class Ticket with fields from, to and fare, a constructor Ticket(String from, String to, int fare), and a second constructor Ticket(String from, String to) that uses fare 100. Print both tickets' fares from main.

prompt.hi: Ticket class लिखिए जिसमें from, to और fare fields हों, constructor Ticket(String from, String to, int fare), और fare 100 लेने वाला दूसरा constructor Ticket(String from, String to)। main से दोनों tickets के fares print कीजिए।

hints.hi: Ticket(String from, String to, int fare) { this.from = from; this.to = to; this.fare = fare; }

hints.te: main లో: new Ticket("Hyderabad", "Vijayawada", 450), new Ticket("Hyderabad", "Warangal").
hints.hi: main में: new Ticket("Delhi", "Agra", 450) और new Ticket("Delhi", "Noida")।

new ClassName(args) దాన్ని నడుపుతుంది

hi: ClassName(params) { this.x = x; } — कोई return type नहीं
new ClassName(args) उसे चलाता है
कई constructors · this(...) दूसरे को call

questions.en: Explain what a constructor is and what happens when you write new Room(101, 3).
questions.te: Constructor అంటే ఏమిటో, new Room(101, 3) రాసినప్పుడు ఏమవుతుందో వివరించండి.
questions.hi: Constructor क्या है और new Room(101, 3) लिखने पर क्या होता है, समझाइए।

questions.en: Explain this.number = number and why the word this is needed.
questions.te: this.number = number, this అనే పదం ఎందుకు అవసరమో వివరించండి.
questions.hi: this.number = number और this शब्द क्यों ज़रूरी है, समझाइए।

challenge.en: Say how a constructor is different from a method.
challenge.te: Constructor, method కి ఎలా భిన్నమో చెప్పండి.
challenge.hi: Constructor, method से कैसे अलग है, बताइए।

oneLine.en: With extends, a child class gets the fields and methods of a parent class and can override methods to behave differently.
oneLine.te: extends తో child class, parent class fields, methods పొందుతుంది; methods ని override చేసి వేరుగా ప్రవర్తించగలదు.
oneLine.hi: extends से child class को parent class की fields और methods मिलती हैं, और वह methods override करके अलग व्यवहार कर सकती है।

useCase.en: A transport app has Vehicle; Bus and Auto extend it and each works out its own fare.
useCase.te: Transport app లో Vehicle ఉంటుంది; Bus, Auto దాన్ని extend చేసి తమ fare తామే లెక్కిస్తాయి.
useCase.hi: Transport app में Vehicle है; Bus और Auto उसे extend करके अपना fare ख़ुद निकालते हैं।

en: class Bus extends Vehicle means a Bus is a Vehicle and gets all of its fields and methods.
The child adds what is new and can override a method with @Override.
super(...) in the child's constructor calls the parent constructor first.
protected fields are visible to child classes but hidden from other code.
A Vehicle variable can hold a Bus: Vehicle v = new Bus(...); v.fare(10) runs the Bus version.
te: class Bus extends Vehicle అంటే Bus ఒక Vehicle, దాని అన్ని fields, methods పొందుతుంది.
Child కొత్తది జోడిస్తుంది, @Override తో method ని override చేయగలదు.
Child constructor లో super(...) ముందుగా parent constructor ని call చేస్తుంది.
protected fields child classes కి కనిపిస్తాయి, ఇతర code కి కనిపించవు.
Vehicle variable లో Bus ఉంచవచ్చు: Vehicle v = new Bus(...); v.fare(10) Bus version నడుపుతుంది.
hi: class Bus extends Vehicle मतलब Bus एक Vehicle है और उसे उसकी सारी fields और methods मिलती हैं।
Child नया जोड़ता है और @Override से method override कर सकता है।
Child के constructor में super(...) पहले parent constructor call करता है।
protected fields child classes को दिखती हैं पर दूसरे code से छिपी रहती हैं।
Vehicle variable में Bus रख सकते हैं: Vehicle v = new Bus(...); v.fare(10) Bus वाला version चलाता है।

en: The child inherits the family business and runs one shop its own way.
te: Child కుటుంబ వ్యాపారాన్ని వారసత్వంగా పొంది ఒక దుకాణాన్ని తన పద్ధతిలో నడుపుతుంది.
hi: Child को परिवार का कारोबार मिलता है और वह एक दुकान अपने तरीक़े से चलाता है।

fix.te: పేరు ఖచ్చితంగా సరిపోవాలి (fare). @Override అలాంటి తప్పులు పట్టుకుంటుంది.
fix.hi: नाम बिल्कुल मेल खाना चाहिए (fare)। @Override ऐसी ग़लतियाँ पकड़ता है।

en: A child class can override a parent method with its own version (@Override).
A variable of the parent type can point to any child: Notifier n = new Sms();
n.send("Hi") runs the Sms version, chosen while the program runs. This is runtime polymorphism.
So an array Notifier[] can mix Sms, Email and WhatsApp, and one loop handles them all.
Overloading (same name, different parameters) is the compile-time kind; overriding is the runtime kind.
te: Child class parent method ని తన సొంత version తో override చేయగలదు (@Override).
Parent type variable ఏ child నైనా చూపగలదు: Notifier n = new Sms();
n.send("Hi") Sms version నడుపుతుంది, program నడుస్తున్నప్పుడు ఎంచుకోబడుతుంది. ఇదే runtime polymorphism.
కాబట్టి Notifier[] array లో Sms, Email, WhatsApp కలపవచ్చు, ఒకే loop అన్నింటినీ నిర్వహిస్తుంది.
Overloading (ఒకే పేరు, వేర్వేరు parameters) compile-time రకం; overriding runtime రకం.
hi: Child class parent के method को अपने version से override कर सकती है (@Override)।
Parent type का variable किसी भी child को रख सकता है: Notifier n = new Sms();
n.send("Hi") Sms वाला version चलाता है, जो program चलते समय चुना जाता है। यही runtime polymorphism है।
इसलिए Notifier[] array में Sms, Email और WhatsApp मिल सकते हैं, और एक loop सबको संभालता है।
Overloading (वही नाम, अलग parameters) compile-time वाला है; overriding runtime वाला।

en: interface Payment { String pay(double amount); } is a promise, not code.
class Upi implements Payment must write pay. So must class Card implements Payment.
A Payment variable can hold any of them: Payment p = new Upi("ravi@okbank");
p.pay(500) runs whichever object p holds. That is polymorphism: one call, many forms.

An abstract class (abstract class Payment { abstract String pay(double a); }) is similar: it cannot be made with new, and it can also hold shared fields and ready methods. Abstraction means showing what something does and hiding how.
te: interface Payment { String pay(double amount); } ఒక వాగ్దానం, code కాదు.
class Upi implements Payment, pay రాయాలి. class Card implements Payment కూడా.
Payment variable వాటిలో దేన్నైనా ఉంచగలదు: Payment p = new Upi("ravi@okbank");
p.pay(500), p లో ఉన్న object ని నడుపుతుంది. ఇదే polymorphism: ఒకే call, ఎన్నో రూపాలు.

Abstract class (abstract class Payment { abstract String pay(double a); }) కూడా అలాంటిదే: దాన్ని new తో చేయలేం, అది ఉమ్మడి fields, సిద్ధమైన methods కూడా ఉంచగలదు. Abstraction అంటే ఏం చేస్తుందో చూపించి ఎలా చేస్తుందో దాచడం.
hi: interface Payment { String pay(double amount); } एक वादा है, code नहीं।
class Upi implements Payment को pay लिखना होगा। class Card implements Payment को भी।
Payment variable इनमें से किसी को भी रख सकता है: Payment p = new Upi("ravi@okbank");
p.pay(500) वही चलाता है जो object p में है। यही polymorphism है: एक call, कई रूप।

Abstract class (abstract class Payment { abstract String pay(double a); }) भी ऐसी ही है: इसे new से नहीं बना सकते, और इसमें साझा fields और तैयार methods भी रह सकते हैं। Abstraction मतलब यह दिखाना कि चीज़ क्या करती है और कैसे करती है यह छिपाना।

oneLine.en: A constructor sets up a new object in one step, and private fields with getters and methods keep its data safe.
oneLine.te: Constructor కొత్త object ని ఒకే step లో సిద్ధం చేస్తుంది; private fields, getters, methods దాని data ని సురక్షితంగా ఉంచుతాయి.
oneLine.hi: Constructor नया object एक step में तैयार करता है, और private fields के साथ getters और methods उसका data सुरक्षित रखते हैं।

useCase.en: A bank account keeps balance private, so no code can set it to a crazy value; money moves only through deposit and withdraw.
useCase.te: Bank account balance ని private గా ఉంచుతుంది, ఏ code దాన్ని విచిత్రమైన value కి మార్చలేదు; డబ్బు deposit, withdraw ద్వారానే కదులుతుంది.
useCase.hi: Bank account balance को private रखता है, ताकि कोई code उसे अजीब value न दे सके; पैसा सिर्फ़ deposit और withdraw से चलता है।

en: A constructor has the class name and no return type: Account(String owner) { ... }.
new Account("Ravi") calls it, so every object starts complete.
this.owner = owner; means "this object's owner gets the parameter owner".
private double balance; hides the field from other classes.
A getter, getBalance(), lets others read it; deposit() checks the amount before changing it. This is encapsulation.
te: Constructor కి class పేరు ఉంటుంది, return type ఉండదు: Account(String owner) { ... }.
new Account("Ravi") దాన్ని call చేస్తుంది, ప్రతి object పూర్తిగా మొదలవుతుంది.
this.owner = owner; అంటే "ఈ object owner కి parameter owner వస్తుంది".
private double balance; field ని ఇతర classes నుంచి దాస్తుంది.
Getter getBalance() ఇతరులు చదవనిస్తుంది; deposit() మార్చే ముందు amount చూస్తుంది. ఇదే encapsulation.
hi: Constructor का नाम class जैसा होता है और कोई return type नहीं: Account(String owner) { ... }।
new Account("Ravi") उसे call करता है, ताकि हर object पूरा बनकर शुरू हो।
this.owner = owner; मतलब "इस object का owner, parameter owner बनता है"।
private double balance; field को दूसरी classes से छिपाता है।
Getter getBalance() दूसरों को पढ़ने देता है; deposit() बदलने से पहले amount जाँचता है। यही encapsulation है।

en: The constructor fills the form; private locks the drawer; methods are the only keys.
te: Constructor form నింపుతుంది; private అర తాళం వేస్తుంది; methods మాత్రమే తాళం చెవులు.
hi: Constructor form भरता है; private दराज़ पर ताला लगाता है; methods ही चाबियाँ हैं।

en: A Student with private marks: setMarks(int m) refuses anything below 0 or above 100.
te: private marks ఉన్న Student: setMarks(int m) 0 కంటే తక్కువ, 100 కంటే ఎక్కువను తిరస్కరిస్తుంది.
hi: private marks वाला Student: setMarks(int m) 0 से कम या 100 से ज़्यादा को मना करता है।

note.en: private: only this class can touch these fields.
note.te: private: ఈ class మాత్రమే ఈ fields ని తాకగలదు.
note.hi: private: सिर्फ़ यही class इन fields को छू सकती है।

note.en: The constructor: same name as the class, no return type.
note.te: Constructor: class పేరే, return type లేదు.
note.hi: Constructor: class का ही नाम, कोई return type नहीं।

note.en: this.owner is the field; owner is the parameter.
note.hi: this.owner field है; owner parameter।

note.en: The method guards the data: negative amounts are ignored.
note.te: Method data ని కాపాడుతుంది: ప్రతికూల amounts పట్టించుకోదు.
note.hi: Method data की रक्षा करता है: negative amounts नज़रअंदाज़।

note.en: A getter lets others read but not change.
note.hi: Getter दूसरों को पढ़ने देता है, बदलने नहीं।

note.en: The constructor runs here.
note.hi: Constructor यहाँ चलता है।

fix.en: A constructor has no return type. With void it becomes an ordinary method.
fix.te: Constructor కి return type ఉండదు. void తో అది సాధారణ method అవుతుంది.
fix.hi: Constructor का कोई return type नहीं होता। void लगाने पर वह सामान्य method बन जाता है।

fix.en: This sets the parameter to itself. Write this.owner = owner;
fix.te: ఇది parameter ని తనకే ఇస్తుంది. this.owner = owner; రాయండి.
fix.hi: यह parameter को ख़ुद को ही दे देता है। this.owner = owner; लिखिए।

en: Name(params) { this.x = x; } — no return type
private fields · public getters · checks in setters/methods
new Name(args) runs the constructor.
te: Name(params) { this.x = x; } — return type లేదు
private fields · public getters · setters/methods లో checks
new Name(args) constructor నడుపుతుంది.
hi: Name(params) { this.x = x; } — कोई return type नहीं
private fields · public getters · setters/methods में जाँच
new Name(args) constructor चलाता है।

prompt.en: Write class Book with private title and boolean available (true at first), a constructor, getTitle(), isAvailable(), and borrow() that returns true and marks it unavailable only if it was available. Write class Library with a private Book[] of size 10 and a count, add(Book), borrow(String title) and availableCount(). Print the result of borrowing "Godan" twice and the available count.
prompt.te: Private title, మొదట true అయిన boolean available, constructor, getTitle(), isAvailable(), అందుబాటులో ఉంటేనే true return చేసి unavailable గా గుర్తించే borrow() ఉన్న Book class రాయండి. Size 10 private Book[], count, add(Book), borrow(String title), availableCount() ఉన్న Library class రాయండి. "Godan" ని రెండుసార్లు borrow చేసిన ఫలితం, available count print చేయండి.
prompt.hi: Private title और शुरू में true वाले boolean available के साथ Book class लिखिए: constructor, getTitle(), isAvailable(), और borrow() जो सिर्फ़ उपलब्ध होने पर true return करे और उसे unavailable करे। Library class लिखिए: size 10 का private Book[] और count, add(Book), borrow(String title) और availableCount()। "Godan" को दो बार borrow करने का result और available count print कीजिए।

hints.en: Book: private String title; private boolean available = true; boolean borrow() { if (!available) return false; available = false; return true; }
